description: SVG of one icon in a style, two colours and a stroke weight, and code to save in a project: code "tsx" (default) is a React component (size, className and title props; main colour currentColor so text colour classes work; accent from the CSS variable --icon-accent), "html" an inline SVG snippet, "svg" the file only. format "svg" is a still icon (1-2 filled paths, works in PowerPoint, Figma, web); "anim-svg" plays its motion in browsers with no player or script.

accent.description: Accent colour for the duo style, hex like #FFB020

code.description: tsx (default): a React component · html: an inline SVG snippet · svg: the SVG file only

id.description: Icon id from search_icons (old ids still work)

lang.description: Language of the label and licence link (as in search_icons). Default en

mode.description: anim-svg only: loop (default), once, or hover

weight.description: Stroke weight for line and duo, 0.5-2.5. Default auto: by size when you give one (24 px = 1.75, 48 = 1.25, 128+ = 0.75), else 1.25

name: get_icon
title: Get icon SVG
